title: Fleer #135 Nate Robinson New York Knicks Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Elevate your collection with the 2006 Fleer #135 Nate Robinson New York Knicks NBA Basketball Card. This piece captures the essence of the NBA with its crisp design and features Nate Robinson, a standout athlete known for his dynamic presence on the court. A must-have for fans of the sport, this card belongs to the esteemed Fleer Base Set, showcasing the quality and attention to detail that collectors and basketball enthusiasts value.

With its association to the 2006 NBA season, this card not only represents a piece of sports history but also serves as a tribute to Robinson's tenure with the New York Knicks. Card Number 135 from the Fleer Set is a noteworthy acquisition for anyone looking to commemorate the player's contribution to basketball or to add a touch of NBA nostalgia to their collection.
